title: Operator onboarding workflow PRD — SSO-linked KMS handshake and audit evidence matrix
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Executive summary: This PRD defines the operator onboarding workflow for Private deployments that ties SSO (SAML) identity assertions to short‑lived operator roles, the KMS/HSM key handshake for operator key escrow, and an evidence matrix of audit events required for compliance signoff. The goal is a repeatable, testable onboarding flow that satisfies SOC2/ISO controls for admin access and key custody while enabling a minimal manual operator surface.

Scope (in):
- Automated SAML metadata ingestion and mapping into RBAC templates (operator-read, operator-write, operator-admin).
- A KMS handshake that creates an operator-specific envelope key, wrapped by an HSM-backed root key, with an escrow copy stored in customer-controlled KMS if requested.
- Audit event schema and retention (enterprise: 13 months immutable, standard: 3 months) and streaming to customer SIEM.
- Attestation UI in Console to capture operator onboarding evidence (SAML assertion, 2FA attestation, policy approvals).

Scope (out):
- Full protocol migration from OIDC to SAML (we support SAML only in this scope).
- Multi-cloud escrow broker (phase 2).

Key decisions so far:
- Use SAML attribute 'eduPersonScopedAffiliation' + custom 'redwood:role' claim to map identities to RBAC templates.
- HSM-backed root keys will be managed by our operator KMS for hosted; private deploys may use customer KMS/HSM via cross‑account key policy.
- Audit log schema will be JSON LTS (structured events) with canonical fields: timestamp, actor_id, actor_role, action, resource, request_id, before/after, kms_key_id when applicable.

Rollout considerations and scope changes: The original onboarding PRD assumed manual key escrow; engineering proposed an automated escrow handshake. That changed the acceptance criteria to require end‑to‑end encryption tests and escrow verification steps. The change increased estimated effort by ~2 points.

Stakeholders: PM (Ava Martinez), Security Eng (Priya Venkataraman), Infra Eng (Damien Cole), Console UX (Marin Liu), Compliance (Sofia Andersson), Customer Success (Elliot Park).

Success metrics:
- 95% of operator onboarding flows complete without manual intervention in Q1 of rollout.
- All required audit events emitted for 100% of onboarding runs (verified by telemetry).
- Customer acceptance test pass rate >= 90% for private pilot customers.

Sign-off triggers: Security review complete, compliance checklist green, integration tests pass in staging, pilot with 2 customers completed.
acceptance_criteria: SAML metadata import: one-click upload and validation against schema with automated mapping suggestion.
RBAC mapping: at least 3 templates (operator-read/operator-write/operator-admin) unit-tested with 5 example assertions.
KMS/HSM handshake: operator envelope key generated, wrapped with HSM root, and escrow copy verifiable by both Redwood operator tooling and customer-controlled KMS (where configured).
Audit logs: onboarding, key-wrap, role assignment, and any manual overrides emit structured audit events with request_id and kms_key_id fields.
Retention: logs for private deployments stored immutable for 13 months and exported to configured SIEM within 5 minutes of generation.
Attestation UI: Console shows onboarding evidence artifacts and allows export of evidence bundle for audit with cryptographic signature of bundle integrity.
Automated negative tests: tampered SAML assertions are rejected, expired assertions are rejected, HSM unwrap failures produce alert and do not leak unwrapped keys.
End-to-end integration tests: staging runs demonstrate successful onboarding, key-wrap, and audit export for both hosted and private deployment configurations.
signoff_checklist: PM: PRD reviewed and published (Ava Martinez).
Security: Threat model and mitigation reviewed; security issues triaged to ENG backlog (Priya Venkataraman).
Infra/Eng: Integration tests passing in staging and canary (Damien Cole).
Console/UX: Attestation UI accessibility review and design QA passed (Marin Liu).
Compliance: Evidence matrix matches SOC2 control identifiers and legal signoff on evidence retention (Sofia Andersson).
Customer Success: Pilot run plan and customer acceptance criteria agreed (Elliot Park).
Operations runbook: Operator rollback procedure documented and automated rollback tested (ENG-11004).
Documentation: Admin and operator guides, API docs, and export sample artifacts published to Confluence/Docs.
test_plan: Unit: RBAC mapping unit tests with synthetic SAML assertions for templates.
Integration: End-to-end onboarding with test IdP and HSM emulator in staging; verify audit events exported to test SIEM.
Chaos: Simulate HSM unwrap failures and network partition during escrow to validate graceful degradation and alerts.
Security: Fuzz SAML parser and confirm no assertion injection or XSW vulnerabilities; run static code analysis on KMS handshake code.
Pilot: Run full onboarding with 2 pilot customers in private mode; collect evidence bundles and customer feedback.
notes: Engineering proposed automating the escrow handshake which raises cross-account IAM policy questions for customer KMS. Security requested a whitepaper on key custody and legal asked for configurable retention windows per customer contract.
